is_anopheles.evidence: The study tests Anopheles gambiae s.l. (Kisumu and Tiassalé strains) (page 5, 'Mosquitoes').

reports_target_markers.evidence: No resistance markers were genotyped. The text mentions known characteristics of the laboratory strains ('It has a high frequency of 1014F kdr and ace-1 mutations...', page 5) citing prior literature, but performs no genotyping.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No mosquito genotyping was performed; no genotype counts, frequencies, or sample sizes for marker assays are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: All experiments were performed using long-maintained laboratory colonies (Kisumu and Tiassalé) held at the Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine, UK (page 5, 'Mosquitoes'). No field-collected mosquitoes were used.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research paper investigating mosquito host-seeking behaviour using a novel baited-box bioassay.

sub_country_location.evidence: Only laboratory colonies were used; no field collection sites were sampled.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: No field collections were conducted in this study.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Routine laboratory assay study evaluating behaviour of LSTM insectary strains.

supplement.evidence: Supplementary file 1 is a video recording of the baited box assay.

assessment.summary: This study describes and evaluates a benchtop 'baited-box' video bioassay to quantify the behavioural responses and feeding dynamics of Anopheles gambiae s.l. at insecticide-treated and untreated nets using laboratory colonies (Kisumu and Tiassalé). No field collections or resistance marker genotyping were conducted.
exclusion_reasons: Does not genotype any target insecticide-resistance markers.
Does not report extractable genotype data.
Tested only laboratory colonies (Kisumu and Tiassalé maintained at LSTM), not African field-collected populations.
